CPO 0002 AIMS TO ENABLE MILITARY UTILITY ASSESSMENTS OF COMMERCIAL TECHNOLOGY WITHIN A COMMON ENVIRONMENT, SIMILAR TO THE MILITARY OPERATIONAL CAPABILITY BUT OUTSIDE EXISTING MILITARY PROGRAMS. WHEN POSSIBLE, DATA FROM THE ASSESSED SYSTEM WILL BE PROVIDED FOR INTEGRATION AND TEST WITH EXISTING MILITARY SYSTEMS. THIS SOW INCLUDES TASKS AND OBJECTIVES THAT THE INTERMEDIARY TEAM WILL PERFORM. THIS CPO WILL USE COMMERCIAL AND AIR FORCE FACILITIES AND INFRASTRUCTURE TO FURTHER THE TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER POTENTIAL OF AF, COMMERCIAL, AND PUBLIC INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY, CAPABILITIES, AND CONCEPTS.
